issues.description: Read safety documentation105-110, exec contracts208-215 and244-247, complete trait and new roundtrip326-331. Only into_raw(from_raw(raw))=raw is promised, under has_safe_slot. This does not imply from_raw(into_raw(item))=item without injectivity of into_raw, which no trait clause provides. Raw projection may discard an item tag while from_raw chooses canonical tag. Thus documented recovery of exact consumed item is not available to generic proof clients. No Verus execution claimed.
